title: Oxfordshire County Council says targeted consultation 'fails to meet three of the four Gunning Principles'
summary: GARD reports that OCC's submission to the targeted consultation on access points called for the DCO submission to be delayed, citing failure to meet Gunning Principles.

title: Three joint ventures shortlisted for White Horse Reservoir main works contract
summary: Thames Water shortlists three joint ventures for the £5.7bn main works contract. Bids expected spring 2027, contract award autumn 2027.

title: White Horse Reservoir Growth Coalition launched at parliamentary event
summary: Growth Coalition launched by BusinessLDN and Thames Valley Chamber of Commerce with eleven founding members. Supporters say reservoir will unlock economic development.

title: Targeted consultation on access points opens; Thames Water acknowledges higher construction traffic
summary: Targeted consultation runs to 7 October 2026. Access points raised from 6 to 17. Thames Water acknowledges 'overall construction traffic movements will be higher than previously forecast'.

title: Pre-application Programme Document published by Thames Water
summary: Thames Water publishes the Pre-application Programme Document setting out the timetable for DCO submission, now expected November 2026.
